sources.title: GitHub - huggingface/cosmopedia
sources.snippet: Here you can find the code used for creating Cosmopedia, a dataset of synthetic textbooks, blogposts, stories, posts and WikiHow articles generated by Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1. It contains over 30 million files and 25 billion tokens, making it the largest open synthetic dataset to date. sources.title: Cosmopedia Dataset Creation | huggingface/text-clustering | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Cosmopedia is a synthetic dataset created using prompts derived from real web content. The text-clustering system was used to analyze web samples and extract structured information that would guide synthetic data generation.
